metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-q0[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Guarantee one agent per workspace[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Two SASE agents can never run in the same workspace checkout: [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]workspace allocation is atomic on every path, a destructive [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]workspace preparation refuses to run when another live agent [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]occupies the checkout, and every RUNNING-field mutation is recorded[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]so a future occupancy incident is diagnosable from the ledger [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]alone.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]workspace_exclusivity.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/workspace_exclusivity.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-q0[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-q0/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Durable RUNNING-field mutation ledger[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]ledger[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ledger: record every workspace claim, transfer, hold, and release to a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]durable JSONL ledger with the full before/after occupancy of the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]affected workspace, so a vanished or duplicated claim row is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]attributable after the fact.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Atomic workspace allocation on every path[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]atomic[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]atomic: replace the deferred-workspace check-then-claim with the atomic [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]allocate-and-claim helper, materialize the checkout only after the claim[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]is held, and remove the remaining unchecked pinned-target claim.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Refuse destructive preparation of an occupied checkout[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]after atomic[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]guard: write a per-checkout occupant record when an agent takes a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]workspace and make every destructive preparation path verify exclusive [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]occupancy before it cleans, resets, or checks out, failing the run [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instead of deleting another agent's work.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Detect and surface occupancy conflicts[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]detect[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ledger, guard[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]detect: add a doctor check and a concurrency regression test that prove [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]simultaneous allocation bursts never hand the same workspace to two [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]agents and that a conflicting occupant is reported rather than silently [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]overwritten.[/#D7D7AF]
